note: Sanborn County (46111) has no zoning district layer in ArcGIS Online or on the First District ArcGIS host (which serves Beadle and other neighbours; no Sanborn folder exists there). The county Equalization/Planning & Zoning office (604 W. 6th St, Woonsocket) is the zoning authority, but no public GIS service of zoning districts was found; the city of Woonsocket site has no zoning map or service. Third-party aggregators (gismaps.org, countyoffice.org, Regrid, Dynamo Spatial) offer only parcels or are paid.
